RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: It is illegal to possess medical cannabis that has been diverted from a registered qualified patient, caregiver, or licensee. Alabama does not authorize adult-use possession.

RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Alabama?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: Yes – it is illegal to distribute, possess, manufacture, or use medical cannabis or a medical cannabis product that has been diverted from a registered qualified patient, a registered caregiver, or a licensed cultivator, processor, secure transporter, dispensary, or a state testing laboratory.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: Alabama’s first medical cannabis dispensary opened on June 4, 2026. The Commission expects other dispensaries to open during summer 2026. Information on dispensary openings is available at https://amcc.alabama.gov/patients/.
